placement_summary: Mardu Horde is a source-authored live-repair raw packet. Its strongest source-bound signals are Red-centered speed, total commitment, martial code, war names, Edicts of Ilagra, Khans-era raiding, Zurgo-era anchors, Alesha bridge context, Kolaghan boundary, modern Dragonstorm timeline labeling, and false-positive boundaries against generic RWB/WBR, Commander products, color-pair proof, Dragonstorm backfill, and seed files.

moral_and_psychological_profile.summary: Vox Mana models Mardu as speed through chosen commitment: act while the opening exists, bind the charge to code and formation, and take the exposed advantage before the field closes. This is project interpretation from normalized MARDU evidence plus VM-224/VM-225 shaping docs, not official canon; VM-299 repairs source-durable live placement after VM-228 promotion.
moral_and_psychological_profile.notes: Psychological language is Vox Mana synthesis. Support-only rows do not raise confidence.

core_values.label: Immediate Commitment
core_values.description: The opening matters because it can close; Mardu acts before hesitation becomes defeat.

core_values.label: War-Bound Code
core_values.description: Speed is shaped by Edicts, war names, formation, khan authority, and respect earned through deeds.

core_values.label: Opportunity With Teeth
core_values.description: Mardu opportunity is immediate martial opening, not slow resource conversion or generic appetite.

behavioral_signals.signal: Look for Red-centered Mardu speed, early pressure, rapid coordinated attack, all-in aggression, total commitment, and war-name identity as primary language.
Look for Alesha bridge context only when it stays tied to ancient/Fate Reforged war-name and identity evidence rather than full biography claims.
Look for modern Dragonstorm Mardu only when the era is explicit and not used to backfill Khans-era Mardu Horde.

inhibitor_traits: RWB or WBR color composition without a positive Mardu evidence cluster
Generic aggro, sacrifice, tokens, aristocrats, reanimator, Vampire tribal, Outlaws/Treasure, attack-triggered large threats, Human tribal, or legendary goodstuff without Mardu evidence
Boros-style Red-White combat without Black opportunity and Horde evidence
Orzhov-style White-Black hierarchy without Red speed and raid momentum
Rakdos-style Red-Black appetite without White code, formation, and war names
Kolaghan clan treated as Khans-era Mardu Horde continuity
Modern Dragonstorm reforms used as Khans-era proof
Commander product color identity treated as Tarkir canon
Color-pair philosophy files treated as Tarkir lore proof
Exact raid, dash, mobilize, full biographies, Commander legality, or exact Dragonstorm chronology used without direct evidence
good_fit_indicators: The candidate centers speed, action, early pressure, and all-in commitment with explicit Mardu or Tarkir Horde anchors.
The candidate uses war names, Edicts of Ilagra, khan authority, Horde roles, Wingthrone, Goldengrave, The Scour, or Screamreach as bounded Mardu evidence.
The candidate clearly labels Alesha, Kolaghan, or Dragonstorm context by era and avoids backfill.
ideal_fit_indicators: Red-centered speed plus White martial code plus Black opportunity are all present.
Khans-era Horde evidence is present, and any Fate Reforged, Kolaghan, or Dragonstorm material is timeline-labeled.
False positives are explicitly rejected: generic color code, Commander products, seed prose, exact mechanics, and backfilled timelines.
poor_fit_indicators: The candidate prefers patient resource accumulation, careful setup, long endurance, or positional advantage over early pressure and decisive action.

The candidate is only RWB/WBR color identity, Commander support texture, generic aggro, sacrifice, tokens, aristocrats, reanimator, Kolaghan continuity, Dragonstorm backfill, seed files, color-pair philosophy, or exact mechanics without a positive Mardu evidence cluster.

discriminator_questions.question: Is the signal about immediate, war-bound action rather than long endurance, institutional technique, hidden resource conversion, or survival through attunement?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Separates Mardu immediate raid-momentum identity from Abzan endurance, Jeskai institutional technique, Sultai hidden conversion, and Temur survival through attunement.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports Mardu when the user centers speed, total commitment, war code, and taking the opening before it closes.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens Mardu when the user centers patience, long endurance, careful preparation, positional advantage, hidden resource conversion, or attuned survival instead of decisive action.

discriminator_questions.question: Does the candidate include a positive Mardu evidence cluster beyond RWB/WBR color identity or Commander support texture?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Guards against generic RWB/WBR and Commander false positives.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports Mardu when war names, Edicts, speed-as-doctrine, Zurgo or Alesha timeline labels, or Mardu Horde lore appear together with Red-centered commitment.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens Mardu when the answer is only RWB/WBR color composition, generic aggro, generic sacrifice, tokens, aristocrats, reanimator, Vampire tribal, Outlaws/Treasure, or Commander product identity.

discriminator_questions.question: Are Alesha, Kolaghan, and Dragonstorm references held inside their timeline boundaries?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Prevents cross-era bleed between Khans-era Mardu, Fate Reforged Alesha material, Kolaghan separation, and modern Dragonstorm context.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports Mardu when Alesha, Kolaghan, and Dragonstorm references are timeline-labeled and used as boundaries or source-backed bridges.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens Mardu when Kolaghan is treated as Khans-era Mardu continuity or modern Dragonstorm reforms are backfilled into Khans-era Mardu Horde proof.

use_when: A user asks for speed, decisive action, martial code, war-name identity, total commitment, raiding motion, or Mardu-specific Tarkir flavor.
A user distinguishes Mardu from generic Commander products or adjacent color-pair patterns.
A user wants timeline-labeled Tarkir clan identity rather than generic RWB/WBR play patterns.
avoid_when: The user only mentions RWB/WBR color identity.
The user centers Commander legality, exact decklists, or product facts.
The user asks for exact raid, dash, or mobilize rules without later card-data validation.
The user centers Kolaghan continuity, Dragonstorm backfill, or seed-file claims as proof.

placement_quality.notes: VM-299 repairs source-durable Mardu placement after VM-228 live promotion and VM-296 generated-authoring contamination. The repair keeps the ten promoted raw claims as the durable claim floor and does not expand evidence authority.

Require a positive Mardu Horde evidence cluster grounded in Red-centered speed, total commitment, war code, and strict Tarkir timeline boundaries.
